title: PersuadioAI
description: Analyze leads, draft follow-up campaigns, and launch SMS outreach only with explicit human approval.
summary: Analyze leads, draft follow-up campaigns, and launch SMS outreach only with explicit human approval.
offersHint: Analyze leads, draft follow-up campaigns, and launch SMS outreach only with explicit human approval. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.persuadioai.com/mcp · Optional headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. OAuth-capable clients (claude.ai web) need nothing here — the server advertises its Auth0 authorization server via WWW-Authenticate/RFC 9728 and clients sign in interactively. Header-based clients (Claude Desktop/Code, curl) pass Bearer <api-key>; mint one at POST https://api.persuadioai.com/api/api-keys while signed in to the dashboard (shown once; omitting scopes yields a read-only key).

headerDocs.name: Authorization

Header-based clients (Claude Desktop/Code, curl) pass Bearer <api-key>; mint one at POST https://api.persuadioai.com/api/api-keys while signed in to the dashboard (shown once; omitting scopes yields a read-only key).

toolsPreview.name: add_leads_to_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Move leads this account owns into a campaign this account owns. Updates membership only — sends nothing. If the target campaign was already reviewed, its approval token becomes unusable (launch recounts recipients), so a fresh review_campaign_readiness is required before launching.

toolsPreview.name: analyze_lead_source
toolsPreview.description: Summarise the leads in an account or one campaign: how many exist, how many can actually be contacted, how many opted out, and how they break down by status and source. Read-only — sends nothing and changes nothing. Start here when the operator asks what they have to work with.

toolsPreview.name: create_campaign_draft
toolsPreview.description: Create a campaign in draft status with its opening SMS. THIS SENDS NOTHING — a draft cannot deliver a message. It exists so a human can read the exact wording and audience before deciding. The message is rejected if it implies a prior relationship or manufactures urgency. After this, call review_campaign_readiness.

toolsPreview.name: create_lead
toolsPreview.description: Add a single lead to a campaign this account owns. Requires campaign_id plus at least a phone or an email; deduplicates against the account's existing leads by contact detail. Writes a record only — sends nothing, to nobody, ever.

toolsPreview.name: find_lead
toolsPreview.description: Search this account's leads by phone number, email address, or name. Phone matching tolerates formatting differences. Returns masked contact details plus lead ids. Read-only — sends nothing and changes nothing.

toolsPreview.name: get_campaign_status
toolsPreview.description: Report what a campaign has actually done: leads, messages delivered, replies, opt-outs, meetings scheduled, and threads waiting on a human. Omit campaign_id to list every campaign in the account. Read-only. The response includes caveats about which numbers may lag — read them before telling the operator a campaign is or is not working.

toolsPreview.name: get_interested_leads
toolsPreview.description: List leads whose replies were classified as positive or as asking a question, newest first, with the reply text. The classifier is keyword and sentiment based, NOT a language model — the response says so explicitly, and the reply text is included so you can judge for yourself. Read-only.

toolsPreview.name: launch_approved_campaign
toolsPreview.description: SENDS REAL MESSAGES TO REAL PEOPLE. This is irreversible and costs credits. It requires an approval_token from review_campaign_readiness AND the confirmation phrase that review returned, which the HUMAN OPERATOR must give you explicitly. Never generate the confirmation yourself, never infer approval from a previous message, and never reuse an approval issued for a different campaign or a different size. If the operator has not clearly said yes to this exact launch, do not call this tool — ask them.

toolsPreview.name: list_from_addresses
toolsPreview.description: The verified email sender identities (from-addresses) this account can send campaigns from. Read-only; sends nothing. Use before an email-channel readiness review to pick the right sender.

toolsPreview.name: list_leads
toolsPreview.description: Page through this account's leads, optionally filtered by campaign and status. Read-only — sends nothing and changes nothing.

toolsPreview.name: pause_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Stop a campaign from sending anything further. Queued messages that have not yet gone out are skipped; anything already handed to the carrier cannot be recalled. Safe to call when unsure — pausing is reversible and errs toward not contacting people.

toolsPreview.name: recommend_followup_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Propose how to follow up, based on which leads have never been contacted, were contacted without replying, or already replied. Returns segments with counts and a suggested approach for each. Read-only — this is a proposal to discuss with the operator, not a plan that has been put into effect.

toolsPreview.name: review_campaign_readiness
toolsPreview.description: Pre-flight a campaign: how many people would be contacted, on which channels, what it would cost, and which checks pass, warn or fail. SENDS NOTHING. If everything passes, it returns a short-lived approval token and a confirmation phrase — both of which a human operator must authorise before launch_approved_campaign will do anything. Run this before every launch; the token is single-use and campaign-specific.
